summary: Graphex Group Ltd filed a Form 6-K on 2026-05-05 reporting its board's proposal to change its domicile from the Cayman Islands to Hong Kong and adopt new Articles of Association. The proposal requires shareholder approval; no meeting has been scheduled yet. No stake, price, premium, or advisor was disclosed. This is a redomiciliation plan, not an acquisition, divestiture, or other special-situation event. The filing is a foreign private issuer report under Rule 13a-16. The outcome depends on shareholder and regulatory approvals; monitor for meeting announcements and further filings.
